:::{#exr-complementary-subspaces-practice}
#### Testing whether two lines are complementary in $\reals^2$

Two [subspaces](linear-algebra-subspaces.qmd#def-subspace) are [complementary](#def-complementary-subspaces) in $\mathcal{V}$
when their [sum](#def-subspace-sum) is $\mathcal{V}$
and they share only $\vzero$.
Let $\mathcal{S}_1 = \operatorname{span}\cb{(1, 0)}$
and $\mathcal{S}_2 = \operatorname{span}\cb{(1, 1)}$.

Decide whether $\mathcal{S}_1$ and $\mathcal{S}_2$ are complementary in $\reals^2$.

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Solve $a\,(1, 0) = b\,(1, 1)$,
and express $(x, y)$ as $a\,(1, 0) + b\,(1, 1)$.

:::

:::
